g.text: ஸ்ரீ ஜஸ்மா தேவி மஹால், ஈச்சனாரி, கோவை
SRI JASMA DEVI MAHAL · EACHANARI · COIMBATORE

g.inkscape:label: Thirukkural 45
g.text: When love and virtue dwell in the heart and home,
Blessings, Joy and Harmony find its room to bloom.

g.inkscape:label: Page 2 - Programme
Order of ceremony
g.text: Arrival of the bride and groom
Sivathiru Aarooran · Niraimozhi Maanthar Thirumurai Thirumadam, Bhavani

g.inkscape:label: Page 3 - Tamil puzzle
g.text: இடமிருந்து வலமாக அல்லது மேலிருந்து கீழாக · ஒரு கட்டத்தில் ஓர் எழுத்து.
Find 18 words from the two verses on this card. Words run left to right or top to bottom, one Tamil letter per box.

g.inkscape:label: Page 4 - English puzzle & verse
g.text: Find these words across, down or diagonally.

g.inkscape:label: Kurunthokai 40 (English)
g.text: My mom and yours, what are they to each other?
My dad and yours, how are they related?
You and I, how do we know each other?
Yet, like rain fall on red earth,
our hearts in love merged into one.
